release: Dubai Square Business District: The Address of Ambition
quotes: A new commercial and office district of 300,000 square metres, with a total development value of AED 12 billion

Rising beside Dubai Square in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, a new commercial and office district of 300,000 square metres, with a total development value of AED 12 billion, is set to become the most connected, most coveted and most extraordinary place to work on the planet.
The new Dubai Creek Tower, envisioned as an iconic global landmark, will give this address a defining presence on the world stage.
At the centre of Dubai Creek Harbour sits Dubai Square, and wrapped around it rises 300,000 sqm of premium commercial and office space
The office towers frame the square on every side.
Two metro stations serve the district directly, and the office buildings are linked straight into them.
Your team steps off the train, crosses a climate-controlled link and arrives in the lobby
Unlike a traditional enclosed mall, Dubai Square extends into the city. Its boulevards spill out into the streets where your offices stand
Shopping, dining, entertainment, hospitality, residences and offices, all woven into one living district.
Four hotels stand around Dubai Square itself, and eight across the masterplan.
Three park "hearts" sit inside the district, part of 15 parks, 4 ecological green corridors and 13% open space across the masterplan.
